research_questions: How large is original complete-case systematic bias compared with mask variance?
Does the original benefit component reject stable true-probability references?
Does centered-pseudo cluster uncertainty match fixed-cohort Bernoulli-mask uncertainty?
Does restricting to values strictly above the released minimum materially alter the descriptive selection-loss relationship?
freeze_stage: After inspection of original results, before generating any new calibration masks

original_analysis.summary: Signed bias, variance, RMSE and median absolute error for all stored cells; SE, interval width, coverage and mean-SE/MC-SD for AIPW
original_analysis.known_probabilities: Finite-population covariance and correlation; T_p-T identity checked numerically
original_analysis.gate: Original fitted low/low candidate and stored oracle-p low-M AIPW, each component separately; original gate unchanged
original_analysis.same_cell_table: Exactly 16 original candidate cells, with probability-loss association, complete-case bias/variance, coverage and all support/error components

new_calibration.population: Original 929 HLM and 922 RLM measured cohorts; original two fixed predictors and SOL/MDR1 coverage targets
new_calibration.paired_uniforms: One 10000 by N uniform matrix per endpoint reused for all mechanisms, anchors and predictors
new_calibration.mask_law: Independent Bernoulli draws within each replicate conditional on fixed probabilities
new_calibration.new_score: Average tied rank of full fixed loss, standardized to zero mean and unit population SD
new_calibration.new_probability: clip(expit(beta*score+intercept),0.1,0.9); intercept bisection matches original endpoint-anchor mean probability within 1e-12
new_calibration.new_mechanism_boundary: Idealized outcome-informed, loss-directed calibration. Not a claim of observational MAR or an identifiable empirical selection model.
methods: misspecified constant-p AIPW with fixed m=T
true-p AIPW with fixed stored low-M from original MAR seed 41001
new_calibration.fixed_m_boundary: m=T is oracle-assisted and not deployable; stored m is held fixed independently of new mask draws, so this is conditional fixed-nuisance calibration, not recalibration of all original cross-fits
new_calibration.design_variance: N^-2 sum p(1-p)/q^2*(L-m)^2, reducing to N^-2 sum (1-p)/p*(L-m)^2 when q=p; exact variance conditional on fixed loss and nuisance predictions
new_calibration.intervals: Normal intervals centered at each estimate using true design variance; legacy centered-pseudo cluster intervals additionally evaluated for two AIPW references. Normal approximation is assessed, not assumed exact.
new_calibration.mc_uncertainty: MC standard error of bias and coverage; Wilson 95% MC intervals for estimated coverage
new_calibration.threshold: Only original benefit/noninferiority component (0.75 for MAR/stress, 1.25 for MCAR) is evaluated in new mechanisms. No formal false-positive or false-negative rate is assigned to the full conjunctive admission rule.
new_calibration.complete_observation_control: p=1, true mask variance exactly zero, legacy centered-pseudo cluster SE reported
new_calibration.estimated_resources: CPU only, under 1 GB memory for this task, minutes not model-training hours
new_calibration.stop_condition: Run exactly the fixed mechanisms and replicates once; no adaptive extra levels, no tuning to pass

nonminimum_sensitivity.subset: Reference strictly greater than minimum released value for each endpoint
nonminimum_sensitivity.fixed: Original prediction and probability vectors, original 100 masks generated over parent N then restricted
nonminimum_sensitivity.recomputed: Subset truth, p-loss association, complete-case and oracle-Hajek mask summaries
nonminimum_sensitivity.boundary: Changes finite population and support. Not directly interchangeable with full-cohort results; no claims about rerun cross-fitted candidate nuisance performance or latent censoring.

paper_mapping.paper_role: claim-carrying diagnostic correction and supporting sensitivity
paper_mapping.section_id: Results admission and uncertainty; Discussion interpretation
paper_mapping.target_display: New supplementary Tables S8 onward and compact main-text summary
paper_mapping.next_route: Write bounded reinterpretation and retain all original decisions as historical operational outcomes
